title: Brazilian Fiscal Data (SICONFI) for Research Pipelines
description: A ScholarSkills package (SS-0011) that queries SICONFI by IBGE code, normalises the field spellings used across RREO/RGF/DCA and aggregates by account prefix so every total can be re-checked. Empty deliveries are reported as findings, rows without a value are skipped rather than recorded as zero.
